nodes.Name: WriteReport
nodes.DocComment: WriteReport implements 'gen report'. args are os.Args[2:].

nodes.Name: deriveHighlights
nodes.DocComment:
deriveHighlights pulls the few headline numbers a reader scans first.
It reads named metrics/cases by their genbench names; anything absent is
simply skipped (no fabrication).

nodes.Name: formatMetric
nodes.DocComment:
formatMetric renders a float as an int when it has no fractional part,
otherwise with up to 4 significant decimals trimmed of trailing zeros.
